release_check.property: every must_fire row nominated, every must_not_fire row silent, or the lane does not ship
release_check.pattern: Semgrep rule tests - ruleid:/ok: annotations run as the rule's own regression
release_check.out_of_reach_is_a_finding: a row here is not excused, it is reported. reach=none means no mechanism of this lane's class can see it; reach=mechanism_not_built names the mechanism that would.

opening_measurement.baseline: 208 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors in the scratch env - the first banked fixture whose suite RUNS. Both earlier fixtures refused with T10 'the gate produced no records at all'.
opening_measurement.what_unblocked_it: envcopy sourced sibling packages from `detect_layout()`'s repo_root, which for a banked fixture is the fixture itself - so zero siblings were copied, `aipass` being a regular package hid the real ones behind the env's own `src`, the fixture conftest's `from aipass.prax import json_handler` failed, and pytest aborted before the hygiene plugin could report. Cured 2026-09-20: siblings come from the running checkout when the target's own root has none, and the choice is published as `sibling_basis`.
opening_measurement.sibling_basis: host_repo - 19 siblings copied from the running checkout. The TARGET is frozen at b710a2b9; its dependencies are not, and the artifact says so rather than implying the whole env was frozen.

must_fire.source_row: round 2 brief 1, '35 assertions of the form reason in captured.err. 31 of 68 red at COLUMNS=40'
must_fire.why: Reproduced independently 2026-09-20: 31 of 68 red at COLUMNS=40, 0 of 68 at COLUMNS=200. Over the whole branch suite, 76 of 209 diverge - exactly the number devpulse measured from a separate seat. This row pins that the axis KEEPS convicting them.

must_fire.source_row: round 2 brief 2, 'under plain pytest -n 4 with COLUMNS untouched, 2 of 68 fail ... I do not think the width axis in its current form sees it'
must_fire.why: MEASURED, AND THE BRIEF'S PREDICTION WAS WRONG: the width axis DOES see it. Under `pytest -n 4` with COLUMNS untouched, 2 of 68 fail - both parametrizations of test_a_file_that_is_not_there_is_refused_rather_than_read_as_empty. Both are already inside the 31 the axis convicts at COLUMNS=40. Across the whole 209-test suite, 2 of 2 xdist failures fall inside the 76 width-divergent nodeids; 0 fall outside. Mechanism: the xdist worker id lengthens tmp_path until the path wraps mid-token at the DEFAULT width - captured.err reads '.../now\nhere.txt'. Same root cause, second lever: path length rather than terminal width. This is a second sample point on one axis, not a new axis.
must_fire.limit: Containment is empirical on this tree, not a proof. It holds because the only mechanism here is wrap-at-width and xdist only lengthens the string; an xdist failure from a NON-width cause (shared state, ordering, parallel file contention) would not be covered. The axis is not a general xdist guard.

must_fire.source_row: round 2 brief 6, 'the top Commands and Examples strings in canary.py are not read by any test in the whole branch suite'
must_fire.why: Second sighting. Whole-body gutting cannot isolate these: the help printer has other work in it. Statement deletion is the operator built for exactly this, and this row is what it was commissioned against.

must_fire.source_row: round 2 brief 7, 'the same three pseudo-tested display functions in canary.py, third sighting: _module_summary, print_introspection, print_help'
must_fire.why: Pre-existing display code, third sighting. The gutting group finds these WHEN IT CAN RUN - and before 2026-09-20 it could not run on any banked fixture at all. This row is the regression pin for both the finding and the env fix that made it reachable.

must_not_fire.source_row: round 2 brief, 'must_not_fire: the 68 real cases. Specifically do not let redundancy read as vacuity'
must_not_fire.why_false: Round A found the 68 cases collapsing to 48 distinct kill-signatures with only 15 being the sole killer of any mutant. That is a well-factored suite, not a weak one - one error() mutation killing 32 refusal cases at once is the CODE being well factored. Zero vacuous cases across all three rounds. Any static nomination against these 68 is a false positive.
must_not_fire.scope: every pytest.static_* group must be silent on tests/test_top.py - one scope row rather than 68 written out, so the key needs no edit when canary adds a parametrize case

must_not_fire.why_false: A case that shares a kill-signature with another case is redundant, not vacuous. No group may nominate a test for being killed by the same mutant as its neighbour.
must_not_fire.scope: no group may report a row whose only evidence is a shared kill-signature

out_of_reach.source_row: round 2 brief 3, 'the [already_sorted] case names itself in its own docstring as the control for tie-break ordering ... I suspect this one is reachable statically. Speculative - measure before believing me.'
out_of_reach.why: MEASURED AND THE SUSPICION IS SOUND, but the rule is not built. The shape - a parametrized case whose id or docstring claims a property its input does not vary along - needs a static rule that reads the case id, the docstring claim and the fixture value together. Nothing in the static tier reads a parametrize id against its own data today. Declared, not built; it does not belong in must_fire until it is.

out_of_reach.source_row: round 2 brief 4, 'the test round-trips through json.loads, the docstring promises bytes. An ensure_ascii flip survives.'

out_of_reach.source_row: round 2 brief 5, 'six content-stripping mutations on refusal messages all green - offending token, path, byte offset, strerror, prefix, suggestion'
out_of_reach.why: Agreed reach=none and agreed low value. The tests assert a reason phrase is present; they do not assert what else the message carries, and no mechanism of this lane's class disagrees with a message that is merely less helpful. Nothing in the tree contradicts anything else.

instrument_findings.what: Both previously banked fixtures refused with T10 'the gate produced no records at all - the plugin never reported'. The sentence names the symptom and nothing about the cause.
instrument_findings.root_cause: envcopy._build_aipass_env sourced siblings from detect_layout()'s repo_root. For a banked fixture that IS the fixture directory, whose src/aipass holds only the frozen branch, so _place_siblings copied zero packages. `aipass` is a regular package and the env's src goes first on PYTHONPATH, so the real siblings were hidden rather than merged, the fixture conftest's `from aipass.prax import json_handler` failed, and pytest aborted before the hygiene plugin's sessionfinish could write a record.
instrument_findings.cure: sibling_source() takes siblings from the running checkout when the target's own root has none, raises EnvError naming both roots when neither has any, and publishes the choice as sibling_basis. Fixture three's baseline then came back green at 208 passed.
instrument_findings.note: This is round 0's C2 finding one level out: not 'the probes grade the installed tree' but 'the probes could not grade anything at all, and said so in a sentence about a plugin'.

instrument_findings.what: Row 2 predicted the width axis would NOT see the xdist variant. It does - 2 of 2, with 0 outside the divergent set.
instrument_findings.why_it_matters: Second round running that a ranking handed to the lane was wrong in the direction of underestimating an instrument that was BUILT AS A VERDICT DIFF. A shape matcher would have had to be taught the xdist shape; an axis that subtracts verdicts got it for free, because a second lever on the same mechanism produces the same divergence.
